prompt:
A pavement seen from directly above, vertical frame, graphic and clean: on
one side a bicycle strip painted a faded dusty brick red, muted and desaturated, closer to weathered terracotta than to bright red,
with a white bicycle pictogram, on the
other grey pavement slabs, the painted line between them straight across the
frame. The two strips fill the picture edge to edge. Daylight, overcast and
flat.
